GSE149383 (Aissa et al., 2021) records the response of 2,739 human lung cancer cells to the drug Erlotinib, and GSE117872 (Sharma et al., 2018; Ravasio et al., 2020; Suphavilai et al., 2021) records the response of 1,302 human oral squamous cancer cells to the drug Cisplatin.
Since scBERT is pretrained on human single-cell data and can not transfer effectively to mouse data, it is not selected as a baseline for the cell type annotation task.
